name: Outdoor 572 Pure Cube Sauna
description:
Outdoor 572 Pure Cube Sauna – 3-4 Person is a complex and stunning design that features a full glass door between the large window panels on the front wall. Revamp your outdoor entertainment area with optional semi-privacy panels that still feature the double pane tempered glass with a fixed cedar grill on the outside.

•	Comfortably Seats 3-4
•	5.5' W x 7' L x 7.5 H (173x214x231cm)
•	Crafted from Canadian Clear or Knotty Red Cedar
•	Glass Sauna Door
•	2-Tier Benches
•	Tempered Glass Windows

* Please note: Electric heaters require a certified electrician to hardwire the unit directly into your electrical panel.
